resources.string: Turns on the Palette and Parameters filter panel and the Original colour style in the Xiaomi Camera, with the Leica Essential mode in the standard UI and an optional CMOS (M10R) style.
Leica Essential Mode in Standard UI
Show Leica Essential mode (M3/M9) in the standard UI mode strip. Note: M3/M9 processing requires 17 Ultra hardware and will not work on 14 Ultra.
Enable the Leica Looks panel in the filter strip. When off, uses the standard filter UI.
Add the CMOS (M10R) style to the photography styles picker. Requires Leica UI enabled.
Enable extra film simulation filters: R600, P100F, F-50, KC64, KP160.
